subject: A packing-list teardown video
question: Will you do a video that tears down a real packing list, item by item?
draft: Yes, this is on the list. I will pick one real packing list from the community, go through it item by item, and say what I would leave at home. Post yours in Solo Travelers and I will choose one.

subject: A "my first solo trip" starter series
question: Would you make a starter series for people planning their first solo trip?
draft: I would love to. A short series that follows one first trip from booking to the last day, with the mistakes left in. Tell me where you would want to start and I will plan around it.

subject: A live Q&A from a night train
question: Can you do a live Q&A from a night train?
draft: A night train Q&A sounds fun, and the wifi is the only risk. I will try it on my next overnight route and post the date here first.

subject: Visit the places your fans recommend, one per month
question: Will you visit a place your fans recommend, one per month?
answer: Yes, starting next month. Each month I will pick one place from the recommendations in Food Finds and Road Trips, visit it, and share what I found. Keep the suggestions coming, and tell me why that place matters to you.
